title: Refuse to classify on missing answers
story: As the AI governance lead, I want a use case with unanswered screening questions to get no category, so that a gap never turns into a silent 'minimal risk'.
acceptance: Any missing screening field, unknown role, unknown practice code or unknown Annex III area gives 'insufficient information' with the missing fields listed and no obligations

title: Detect prohibited practices
story: As the chief compliance officer, I want prohibited uses flagged first, so that the committee can stop them before anything else is discussed.
acceptance: A declared Art. 5 practice or workplace emotion recognition gives 'prohibited' with the article, one Stop obligation due 2 Feb 2025, and overrides any Annex III or transparency flag

title: Classify Annex III high-risk uses
story: As the AI governance lead, I want insurance pricing, credit and recruitment uses classified as high-risk with their obligations, so that remediation can be planned and funded.
acceptance: Annex III areas give 'high-risk' with Arts 9-17, 43, 47, 49, 72 (provider) and Art 26 (deployer) due 2 Dec 2027; points 5(b) and 5(c) add the Art 27 FRIA for deployers; point 4 adds worker information

title: Handle Art. 6(3) derogation claims
story: As in-house counsel, I want derogation claims sent to me rather than accepted, so that no high-risk system is waved through on an owner's say-so.
acceptance: A claimed ground without profiling gives 'not high-risk (Art. 6(3) claimed, legal review)' with Art 6(4) and Art 49(2) duties; with profiling the claim is rejected with the reason and the use stays high-risk

title: Transparency duties and their dates
story: As the head of digital channels, I want to know which transparency duties apply to my assistants and when, so that customer-facing AI is disclosed on time.
acceptance: Art 50(1)-(4) duties follow the screening flags; marking for systems in service before 2 Aug 2026 is due 2 Dec 2026, otherwise 2 Aug 2026; no flag and no Annex III gives 'minimal risk' with no obligations

title: Obligations follow the organisation's role
story: As the AI governance lead, I want provider and deployer duties separated, so that buying a vendor tool and building our own are planned differently.
acceptance: Deployer-only use cases get no provider duties (HR-*, TR-MARKING); provider-only get no deployer duties; provider_and_deployer gets both; deployers of generators are told marking is the vendor's duty

title: Load evidence with data-quality checks
story: As the AI governance lead, I want evidence rows checked, so that 'done' means a reference someone can open.
acceptance: Unknown status is treated as missing; 'done' with no reference becomes partial; rows for unknown use cases or for obligations that do not apply are reported in the data-quality section and ignored

title: Deadlines and status per use case
story: As the chief risk officer, I want each use case marked red, amber or green from its deadlines and evidence, so that I see where we are already late.
acceptance: Red = prohibited or an obligation past its date without done evidence; amber = open obligations, insufficient information or a derogation in review; green = all applicable obligations done; days left computed from --as-of

title: AI literacy coverage by role group
story: As the chief people officer, I want literacy coverage by role group against our own target, so that training goes first to people who operate high-risk systems.
acceptance: Coverage = completed / in scope per group; groups below --literacy-target are listed in the decisions, naming those operating high-risk systems; invalid rows are reported and skipped; the pack states the target is a policy choice under the amended Art 4

title: Executive readiness pack
story: As the chief data and AI officer, I want a pack that opens with the decisions the committee owns, so that the meeting is about choices rather than reading tables.
acceptance: Markdown and JSON written; decisions come before the tables; the pack states the legal basis and that it is not legal advice; the words 'compliant' and 'certified' never appear

title: Sample portfolio shows every answer
story: As a reviewer of this tool, I want a sample portfolio that exercises every category and status, so that I can judge the logic in ten minutes.
acceptance: Sample has one or more use cases per category, red, amber and green, two data-quality findings and six decisions; checked in CI

title: Changes since the last review
story: As the AI governance lead, I want the pack to show what moved since the previous review, so that the committee sees progress and slippage.
acceptance: Given two JSON packs, lists category changes, newly overdue obligations and evidence moved to done, by use case

title: Screening questionnaire for owners
story: As a use-case owner, I want a short questionnaire that writes the screening answers, so that I do not need to know article numbers.
acceptance: Plain-language questions map one-to-one to the screening fields; every answer stores the question text and the date; unanswered stays missing

title: Annex I product route
story: As the AI governance lead, I want AI used as a safety component of regulated products flagged, so that the 2 Aug 2028 route is not missed.
acceptance: A product-safety flag gives high-risk under Art 6(1) with obligations due 2 Aug 2028

title: Rules refresh when guidance lands
story: As in-house counsel, I want the rules file versioned and diffed when the Commission's Art 6 guidelines are published, so that classifications are re-run on the new reading.
acceptance: rules.json carries a version; a changed version re-runs the sample and lists every use case whose category or due date moves
